title: fix(core,docs): bare citations that meant an objectstack card name its repository; the RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS.execute pointer among them (objectui#11016)
body:
Fixes #11016
Clause-②: no

Dispatched implementation of the `domain:ui` seat 2 claim (comment `5882822760`) on objectui#11016, triage direction `5876435318`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`. Citations only: a bare number whose sentence means an objectstack card now names its repository as `objectstack-ai/objectstack#N`, as triage direction 2 spells it. No key, accept set, refusal decision or code path moves.

In this body a census number is written in a code span, so GitHub links it to nothing.

## What changed, by class (one commit each)

1. **Runtime strings (2 sites, `patch`).**
   - `@object-ui/core` `RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS.execute`, the dev warning for an action still carrying the retired `execute` key, now reads "`execute` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#3855) — rename the key to `target`. …". The card is live, so the pointer is qualified rather than dropped (triage item 1; ruling `5860244997` Q1 = A covers dead cards only). The rest of the message is byte-identical, and the one test that pins its text (`actionKeys.pin.test.ts`, "rename the key to `target`") still reads it.
   - `@object-ui/app-shell` metadata-admin `default-schemas.ts`, the Studio skill form's `triggerConditions` help text: its two bare numbers mean objectstack cards `1878` and `1895` and now name them.
2. **Source comments.** Every other in-class site is a `//`, `/* */`, JSX or doc comment in non-test `packages/*/src`: 350 bare numbers on 337 lines in 143 files across 24 packages, requalified in place. One more is held (**Held** below).
3. **Pending changesets.** The 10 in-class sites in 9 pending entries get a dated note each, in the form objectui#10877 used (`⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-29 — … — objectui#11016.**`, what the number means, then "The text above is kept as the reading of this change."). The note names the card and never repeats the bare token. The frontmatter block is md5-identical at the branch point and this head in all nine.
4. **Patch round 1: the qualified form of the same defect (claim amendment `5883408510`, bounded in-place fix, commit `ba91ecf76`).** Two `PackageFormDialog.tsx` comments (the `readEnvelopeUserMessage` docblock and the objectui#8051 catch-arm comment) wrote `objectui#3821` for the generic-substitution card and now write `objectstack-ai/objectstack#3821`. The pending `.changeset/violet-donkeys-brake.md`, which would publish that spelling at the next release, gets a dated note in the form of the other nine: it names objectstack-ai/objectstack#3821, the sharing-rule dialog card. Its frontmatter md5 is `4e8ce550` at both `29d0e9ae2` and `ba91ecf76`. The test file's doc comment is untouched, because tests are outside the class. Evidence on `ba91ecf76`: the comment-stripping print of `PackageFormDialog.tsx` is identical to `29d0e9ae2`, with 0 parse diagnostics; `pnpm exec vitest run` over the five `PackageFormDialog.*.test.tsx` files gives `Test Files  5 passed (5)`, `Tests  67 passed (67)`; `pnpm exec eslint` on the file gives 0 errors; `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0; trial merges are unchanged.

Plus `.changeset/11016-cross-repo-bare-citations.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, the two packages whose shipped runtime text moves; the comment-only packages need no entry of their own, as in the objectui#10803 batches: every package here versions as one group.

## Census (read before editing)

**Population.** The instrument is the one objectui#10803's batches used. Its primary form is below; the blind-spot form swaps the lookbehind for `(?<=[/.\-])`:

```
git grep -nP '(?:^|(?<=[^\w#&/.\-]))#\d+(?![0-9A-Za-z_])' REF -- '.changeset/*.md' 'packages/*/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/*.test.*' ':!**/*.spec.*' ':!**/test/**' ':!**/tests/**'
```

At the branch point `e327c8998` it finds 3880 bare occurrences: 3694 in the primary form and 186 after `/`, `.` or `-`, with 1005 distinct values. A number written after an already-qualified one (`objectui#9469/#8649`, `framework#1878/#1891`) inherits that qualifier and is out of the bare class.

**Titles.** Both repositories' full issue and pull-request title lists were read over REST: `issues?state=all`, cursor pagination. objectui gives 10653 items (max `11037`); objectstack gives 18394 (max `20567`). A number absent from a list answers 404 there.

**Reading.**
- Every distinct number between 100 and 25000 (952 of them, hex colours excluded) was read with both titles beside every sentence that cites it, grouped by number.
- Where a title did not settle it, the card or the landing commit was read. For example, objectstack `1890`'s comment `4708800480` carries the form-layout note two ObjectView/ModalForm comments cite. objectui PR `2078`, not objectstack's same-numbered release PR, is the spec 11.2.0 bump a clientValidation comment cites.
- The 668 occurrences below 100 were read too: commandment numbers, decision-batch numbers, React error codes and colours, none of them a card. Above 25000 there are only hex colours.

**Verdicts.**
- **objectstack**: 105 numbers, 364 occurrences, 350 lines, 153 files (144 source files, 9 pending changesets). The table below lists them.
- **objectui**: every other card citation, left bare. That includes the sentences in mixed numbers that mean the objectui card: for `2212`, only the six pagination lines mean objectstack's `findData` card, and the `visibleOn` lines stay.
- **neither repository**: 10 numbers (**Acceptance notes** 2).
- **not a card**: decision batches, React errors, and one changeset's GitHub Actions run numbers.

**Lit controls.**
- The review's floor is found in full: all 10 numbers on its 18 lines, plus a third `8955` site the review did not list (plugin-detail `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`).
- The known hit `actionKeys.ts` `3855` is found.
- The negative control holds: `2078` sits beside "spec 11.2.0" and means objectui's bump PR, and it stays bare.

**After, reconciled at this head.** Re-running the instrument, every (file, number) count dropped by exactly the number of sites edited in that file (0 mismatches), and no new bare occurrence appeared anywhere in the classes (0 added). Of the 364, 11 remain: the 10 changeset sites, now carrying their notes, and the 1 held site. The census verdicts come from reading, and nothing re-derives them mechanically; the instrument above re-derives the population.

## Special cases

- **Quotations of objectstack's own text** keep their words, and the card name sits in square brackets, objectui#10803's editorial mark for a substituted word. There are five:
  - `apiErrorEnvelope.ts`, the `(#3821)` in the quoted envelope-writer sentence.
  - `widget.ts`, a quoted `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR` entry.
  - `data-protocol.ts`, a quoted spec comment.
  - `ValueDataSource.ts` and `filter-converter.ts`, a quoted refusal message each.
- **The quoted `(#3821)` is named, and triage's premise about it did not hold.** Triage item 4 says neither `3821` is the card. Measured: objectstack `3821` is the sharing-rule dialog card, and the objectui change that repaired it, objectui#2920 (`53642d4fe`), is the change that first replaced a refused write's raw server text with localized copy, the generic substitution the sentence names. The comment now says that. The three sibling "… holds by construction" comments in `form.tsx`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx` and `ObjectKanban.tsx` mean the same card and are qualified the same way.
- **The paraphrased spec tag `@deprecated [#2578 -> size]`** (calendar, gantt, kanban) is corrected inside its code span, with no extra brackets: the tag's own syntax already uses them.
- **Words folded into the name.** "framework #N" (objectstack's former name), "ObjectStack #N", "ObjectStack framework #N" and "objectstack #N" become the one qualified name. "issue", "PR", "pre-" and "upstream" stay.

## Held (serial rule)

The census hit in `plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the server-side pagination comment ending "reachable at all (framework `2212`).", is not edited. Open draft objectui#10278 inserts lines directly beneath it. Qualifying it here added a conflict hunk: 3 conflict markers in that file against objectui#10278's head, versus 2 without this change. With it held, the count is 2 either way. The line waits for objectui#10278 to land or close.

## Proof of prose-only (C4), against current `main` `2eaf5be27`

- Each of the 144 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files was parsed on both sides with TypeScript's `createSourceFile` and re-printed by `createPrinter({ removeComments: true })`. 142 prints are identical and 2 differ, exactly the two runtime-string files (`actionKeys.ts`, `default-schemas.ts`), with 0 parse diagnostics.
- Lit controls on the same instrument: re-spacing a comment in `actionKeys.ts` leaves the print unchanged, and editing its string literal moves it. Both anchors were confirmed on disk, one each.
- Both changed literals are values in string-keyed `Record` types whose values are typed `string` and `unknown`, so no type moves.

## Serial and trial merges

`main` was merged in before opening (`29d0e9ae2`). objectui#11038, #11036, #11034 and #11032 had landed in the meantime; the auto-merges in `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `en.ts`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx` and plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx` were clean. Re-reading the instrument on the merged tree finds nothing new.

`git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with each open pull request's head, fetched into named refs:
- objectui#11033 (it holds `ActionRunner.ts` and `en.ts`, both of which carry census edits here): clean.
- objectui#10930 (`dashboard-filters.ts`): clean.
- objectui#10278: conflicts in `plugin-grid.mdx`, plugin-grid `README.md` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the same three files as against `main` alone, with the same 2 conflict markers in `ObjectGrid.tsx` (see **Held**).
- objectui#5400 (release): it deletes the pending changesets it consumes, so the 9 noted entries show modify/delete conflicts, as every edit of a pending entry does. It regenerates, and it is not a hold. If it lands first, those notes have no file to land in.

## Gates and tests

Each line gives the gate's own verdict and its exit code, captured by redirect-then-`$?`. On this head `29d0e9ae2`:
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs --base 2eaf5be27`, exit 0: "143 source file(s) of 23 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/11016-cross-repo-bare-citations.md."
- `pnpm changeset:check`, exit 0: fixed group complete; "No changeset declares a `major` bump."
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only), exit 0. Its standing notice lists pending entries that name a touched file. A pending entry quoting a replaced spelling would carry a bare number the census sees, and the census found exactly the nine entries noted here.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, exit 0: "No test source names a pending changeset."
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, exit 0: "OK (scanned 9331 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)."
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, exit 0: "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0".
- `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, exit 0. `pnpm check:action-forward-parity`, exit 0; it reads `RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS` off `actionKeys.ts`. `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`, exit 0: "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/` through the shared verify lock: `Test Files  184 passed (184)`, `Tests  3658 passed | 27 skipped (3685)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `@object-ui/core` type-check, after building its dependency closure (`@object-ui/types`): exit 0.

On `5d8eefd71`, the pre-merge head with the same diff over the older base:
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/`, the whole-tree scanner suite: `Test Files  177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests  5350 passed | 2 skipped (5352)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 144 touched source files: 0 errors. The config enables no type-aware linting and no rule reads comments, and C4 shows no code token moved, so no untouched file's verdict can move either.
- `pnpm check:installed-pin-claims` "OK". `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` exit 0 (1 disagreeing file, within objectui#7882's ceiling). `node scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` "OK every carrier is a DEBT entry". `pnpm check:handler-key-reads` exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 154 paths: "NOT GOVERNED".

**Declared narrowing.**
- Type-check ran for `@object-ui/core` only. The other 23 packages change comments only, and `@object-ui/app-shell` changes one string value typed `unknown` (C4). Their type-check is CI's.
- Package test suites ran for `packages/core/` only. No test pins the app-shell help text: a search of tests, e2e and apps for its wording finds nothing. The rest is CI's.
